label: General
tooltip: FATEs, Critical Encounters, pots, mounting, BOCCHI AI, Triage Mode, Return, and repair.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Pick enabled Magic Pot FATEs first when choosing what to do. Disabled Magic Pot FATEs under Allowed FATEs are still skipped. Also turns on pot timing and waiting near pots (see Pot timing).

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After an enabled pot FATE ends (not between waves), wait for Cache Me If You Can, drink Magical Elixir, and follow the compass. Keeps going while Cache Me is up; stops when that buff is gone. If you have no buff, elixir, or hints, it visits known chest spots instead. Extra reroll chests are under Pot timing.

should_preposition_to_pots.label: Wait near pots before they spawn
should_preposition_to_pots.tooltip: Leave early and stand near where the next pot FATE should appear. Timing is under Pot timing. The next-pot timer resets if you leave Occult Crescent or change instance.

should_do_critical_encounters.label: Do Critical Encounters
should_do_critical_encounters.tooltip: Go to and complete Critical Encounters. While waiting for or fighting a CE, BOCCHI will not Return early just to refresh buffs or idle.

toggle_ai_provider.label: Use BOCCHI AI
toggle_ai_provider.tooltip: In FATE and CE combat, activates the BOCCHI AI autorotation preset in BossMod / BossMod Reborn for targeting and combat movement. Does not enable a job combat rotation (Wrath / Rotation Solver) and does not use the legacy ai:on command. Turns off while traveling and back on when you arrive.

should_auto_mount.label: Mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip: Mount for long trips to a FATE or CE, and remount if you get off mid-way (for example after Treasure Sight).

sprint_on_aetheryte_approach.label: Sprint to aetherytes
sprint_on_aetheryte_approach.tooltip: Use Sprint when walking up to an aetheryte (camp, aethernet shard, or escaping combat during a treasure hunt).

stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.label: Stay mounted while waiting for CEs
stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.tooltip: Do not get off your mount after you arrive at a CE that is still preparing. You still dismount when it starts.

stop_after_return.label: Stop after return and teleport
stop_after_return.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, return to camp, teleport toward the next one, mount, then stop. You walk the rest yourself. Toggle Illegal Mode to resume, or turn this off for full auto.

phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.label: Level phantom jobs automatically
phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.tooltip: When your current phantom job is maxed, switch to the next unlocked one that is not maxed. Skips Freelancer (it does not level from combat). Stays put if every unlocked job is already maxed. Does not switch during Triage Mode or pot chest farming, and does not interrupt Treasure Sight or buffs.

enable_triage_mode.label: Triage Mode
enable_triage_mode.tooltip: Fits into normal Illegal Mode. After a FATE or CE: if dead players nearby still need a raise, briefly switch to your chosen raise job, raise them (skips anyone who already has a raise pending), switch back, then continue as usual (Return / Sight / next activity). If nobody needs a raise, nothing extra happens — no job swap and no waiting. Needs Chemist or White Mage unlocked.

preferred_triage_raise_job.label: Triage raise job
preferred_triage_raise_job.tooltip: Which phantom job to use for raises. If that job is not unlocked, Triage uses the other one when available.

should_cast_treasure_sight.label: Cast Treasure Sight at camp
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip: While idle at base camp, cast Treasure Sight on a timer. Ignored if Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode is on (that already surveys after each CE/FATE). Waits if Triage Mode is currently raising.

treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.label: Treasure Sight every (seconds)
treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.tooltip: How often to cast Treasure Sight at camp when the option above is on.

max_remote_idle_time_seconds.label: Max wait before Return (seconds)
max_remote_idle_time_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE ends (and Triage Mode finishes, if it ran), wait a random time between 2 seconds and this value before casting Return.

max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.label: Max wait before leaving camp (seconds)
max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.tooltip: At camp, wait a random time between 0 seconds and this value before teleporting to a FATE or CE. Helps when people would otherwise leave at the same time. 0 means leave right away.

auto_repair_threshold.label: Repair gear below (%)
auto_repair_threshold.tooltip: At base camp, repair any equipped piece at or below this durability.
